Kai Summers (CS): Quick dump from MarinerHealth kickoff — capture for product/eng triage.
Mina Alvarez (PM): paste raw bullets pls
Kai Summers (CS): Raw notes: 
- Ask: tenant-level deployment freeze (they call it 'audit-lock') to avoid surprise model changes during payer audits.
- Ask: per-environment spend forecast (dev/stage/prod) in Console, with threshold alerts.
- Ask: downloadable reconciliation CSV grouped by route + environment.
- Pain: occasional 500s when their sidecar strips X-Request-ID, makes tracing across services hard.
- Ask: a short enablement checklist + 30m follow-up for ops next Wed.
Devon Brooks (Eng): Quick tech: audit-lock can be a routing-layer boolean + enforcement at deploy time. Forecast view needs aggregation by route+env over rolling 30d; we can add a simple estimator using avg QPS*tokens*model-cost. CSV is straightforward. Sidecar issue — need example logs/config.
Rae Lin (Product): Customer said the forecast + CSV = blockers for procurement. Audit-lock is compliance-critical but can be phased (UI first, enforcement later).
Mina Alvarez (PM): Proposed triage and owners:
- Forecast + alerts -> P0 -> owner: Mina Alvarez -> ETA: 10 business days -> reason: procurement needs number to budget
- Reconciliation CSV -> P0 -> owner: Kai Summers -> ETA: 7 business days -> reason: finance reconciliation
- Audit-lock (UI + opt-in) -> P1 -> owner: Rae Lin -> ETA: next sprint -> reason: compliance, but enforce later
- Sidecar tracing spec -> P1 -> owner: Devon Brooks -> ETA: 3 business days to spec -> reason: debugging/ops
- Enablement checklist + session -> P1 -> owner: Kai Summers -> ETA: next Wed -> reason: handoff
Devon Brooks (Eng): Estimates: CSV endpoint + exporter change ~2 dev-days; forecast prototype ~4 dev-days (backend + small UI); audit-lock UI scaffold ~3 dev-days, enforcement + policy ~5 dev-days; sidecar spec -> need their config -> likely small.
ticket-bot: Created ticket MH-1004: "MarinerHealth  billing forecast & reconciliation CSV" assigned to Mina Alvarez, due in 10 business days.
Kai Summers (CS): Adding acceptance criteria: CSV columns = utc_date, env, route, token_count, cost_cents, currency, customer_note. Forecast alert threshold should be configurable per-tenant and send email to billing contact.
Mina Alvarez (PM): Added smoke-test prompt set requirement to MH-1004 (8 prompts, mix of short/long/structured). Will draft PRD by Thu.
Rae Lin (Product): I'll sketch an audit-lock UX that makes opt-in clear and includes RBAC options. Will attach mock by Tue.
Devon Brooks (Eng): Please upload a minimal sidecar config + a sample trace. I'll validate header passthrough assumptions.
Kai Summers (CS): Uploading recording, example CSV, and sample traces to /customers/marinerhealth/onboard now. Scheduling ops Q&A for next Wed 14:00. :thumbsup:
Mina Alvarez (PM): Thanks team — I'll update MH-1004 when PRD lands. :rocket:
